newsitem.title: USA: Caltex sees Australian Petroleum continuation.
newsitem.headline: Caltex sees Australian Petroleum continuation.

text.p: Caltex Petroleum Corp said Wednesday it expects Australian Petroleum Pty Ltd to continue as the largest supplier of petroleum products in Australia.

Caltex, owned jointly by Texaco Inc and Chevron Corp, said it was taking note of Pioneer International Ltd's recent announcement that it will review their strategic options for Pioneer's 5O percent interest in Australian Petroleum.
The other 50 percent is held by Caltex Australia Ltd, which is 75 percent owned by Caltex Petroleum.
For its part, Caltex said, it intends to remain in the Australian petroleum products market through its interests in Caltex Australia.

"The Caltex-Ampol merger into (Australian Petroleum) has successfully integrated operations of the two companies, and we believe that (Australian Petroleum) is now well positioned to be successful in this market.
"We fully expect that (Australian Petroleum) will continue as the largest, most competitive supplier of petroleum products in Australia," Caltex said.
Earlier, a Caltex Australia statement said "it is too early to speculate on what effect, if any, this review by Pioneer might have on (Caltex Australia's) own position in (Australian Petroleum)."
